name: Eastwall Tower
summary: On the eastern road, Eastwall Tower watches over a wilderness still infested with Scourge. Built as a scout tower for Lordaeron, it fell when the Scourge swept across the kingdom during the Third War.

sections.title: A Ruined Watch on the Border
sections.body:
Eastwall Tower's broken ramparts look down on roads through Scourge-infested countryside. Built to guard Lordaeron's border, it watched travelers bound for the far reaches of the realm. When the Scourge invaded during the Third War, the outpost fell with the settlements around it. Shattered stone arches and burnt timber remain.

The Lich King's armies still infest the region. From its high ground, the ruined tower overlooks the eastern roads.

faq.q: What was Eastwall Tower before it fell?
faq.answer: Before it fell, Eastwall Tower was a defensive scout tower built by the Kingdom of Lordaeron. It formed part of the border watch, guarding trade routes and outlying farms before the Third War brought Lordaeron's fall.

The Scourge destroyed Eastwall Tower during Prince Arthas Menethil's conquest and the undead ravaging of Lordaeron that followed. Undead monstrosities smashed its defenses, killed the defenders and left the tower in ruins.

faq.q: Why is the tower strategically important?
faq.answer: Even in ruins, Eastwall Tower commands high ground along the eastern roads of the Plaguelands. From there, it overlooks Scourge-infested countryside.

faq.q: Is the tower safe to rest at?
faq.answer: Eastwall Tower stands in Scourge-infested countryside and offers no secure refuge.

angles.text: For the Alliance, retaking Eastwall Tower honors Lordaeron's fallen soldiers and secures the approach to Light's Hope Chapel against Scourge incursions.
The ruined scout tower overlooks roads through the hostile northern lands.
